veranderings.voor: doen elkeen 'n ander werk vir die operasie
veranderings.na: het elkeen 'n ander taak by die operasie
veranderings.rede: 'n Ander werk doen vir' reads wooden; 'n ander taak hê by' is the more natural way to say each discovery plays its own part.

veranderings.voor: kan kieme by die wond kom
veranderings.na: kan kieme in die wond kom
veranderings.rede: Germs getting into a wound is more naturally 'in die wond kom'; 'by die wond kom' sounds like merely arriving next to it (preposition choice).
